meta.name: muapi-action-figure-generator
meta.description: Convert a photo of a person into a custom 3D action figure, complete with collectible toy packaging.

copy.tagline: 将人物照片转为定制3D可动人偶及包装
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用照片生成个性化3D人偶玩具
copy.tagline_en: Turn a person's photo into a custom 3D action figure with packaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create a personalized 3D action figure from a photo

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把一张人物照片变成 3D 可动人偶，并配上玩具包装盒。
howto.when: 当你上传人物照片，并提到“人偶”、“定制玩具”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这张照片做成超级英雄主题的人偶。
say.note: Claude 会生成带包装的 3D 人偶图。

say.text: 帮我用这张照片做一个探险家主题的玩具。
say.note: Claude 会按探险家主题生成人偶。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn a photo of a person into a 3D action figure with collectible toy packaging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a person's photo and mention keywords like "action figure" or "custom toy".

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a superhero-themed action figure.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a 3D figure with packaging.

say_en.text: Make an explorer-themed toy from this picture.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the figure with explorer theme.
